title: Text normalization invariant: identifiers bind exact UTF-8 bytes as given (FORMAT.md 3.1) - NFC and NFD spellings of the same logical string are distinct canonical texts and distinct ids
text_utf8_nfd: cafe (NFD spelling: e + combining acute U+0301)

expected.note: The two spellings MUST NOT unify: no normalization, no folding, no trimming anywhere in the engine. Applications normalize before object creation if they want equivalence; verifiers never fold.

verify_ctx.note: Byte-level vector: no pipeline verdict depends on it; harness re-derives ids from the hex and checks re-encode identity.
